result.finding: Application uses Spring profiles with 3 environments: default (development), docker (containerized deployment), and test (automated testing with H2 in-memory database). No Maven profiles or @Profile-annotated beans found.
evidence: application.properties: default profile — Oracle DB at oracle-db:1521/FREEPDB1, spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=create, DEBUG logging
application-docker.properties: 'docker' profile — Oracle at oracle-db:1521:XE (XE service name), INFO logging for production use
src/test/resources/application-test.properties: 'test' profile — H2 in-memory database, H2Dialect, create-drop DDL, no SQL logging
docker-compose.yml: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=docker activates the docker profile for the containerized app
values: Spring profile activation via SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE environment variable
Test profile uses H2 in-memory DB instead of Oracle (no Oracle required for tests)
Docker profile adjusts Oracle service name (XE vs FREEPDB1) and log levels
